latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Give native OpenCode runs the Craft Anything tools and show their tool calls by @advokat11 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/800
* Stabilize loopback request and cancellation fixtures (R3.11) by @Afloat16 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/767
* Keep the model discovery test from depending on OpenCode being installed (R5.2) by @justinjohn0306 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/980
* Start the Advanced console's prompt box at three lines (#942, R2.9) by @justinjohn0306 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/979
* Stop counting a video or music player as a game (#953, R2.7) by @justinjohn0306 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/970
* Add Georgian (ka) UI catalog by @devius in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/775
* List MaterialCraft with the other Craft apps by @zitann2020 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/836
* List MaterialCraft in the Japanese Craft apps table by @zitann2020 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/837
* List MaterialCraft in the Korean Craft apps table by @zitann2020 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/838
* List MaterialCraft in the Chinese Craft apps table by @zitann2020 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/839
* Name the two modes plainly in Japanese: 外から観察 and 中まで解析 by @zitann2020 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/679
* Compare remote query test paths canonically on macOS (R5.2) by @doubektomas in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/949
* Find app.asar beside an .exe target in the study step by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/956
* Show Ghidra's wait and progress lines in the build's activity feed by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/955
* Truncate long app file names on the Make screen by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/869
* Keep zoom between 50% and 200% (R2.9) by @sanketdofe in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/908
* Keep the Advanced console's status clear of its tabs when narrow (R2.9) by @justinjohn0306 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/984
* Claim R5.6: a denied Accessibility permission is not a success by @mavericzz in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/887
* craft-anything-clonar-softwares by @Cleyson in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/985
* Stop sending empty assistant messages to OpenAI-compatible providers by @yashpatadiya1724-cmyk in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/854
* More format parsers keep to their declared lengths and refuse impossible values (R3.12) by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/986
* Record the Windows start-fallback live check: the start after a killed one draws with WARP and opens (R5.1) by @00xJS in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/911
* Check packaged Deep builds before publishing a release (R5.1) by @doubektomas in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/982
* Hide the home scrollbar when scrolling is not needed (R2.9) by @Pratikkk1829 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/988
* List new projects in the sidebar immediately and attach existing folders by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/987
* Put the switches under the prompt box on two lines when they don't fit by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/989
* Add Spanish, Italian and Vietnamese to the app's languages by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/990
* A hand-off that ends just before a kill reports its exit, and its Windows test waits for the launcher (R5.2) by @00xJS in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/910
* Count cached tokens in usage.json (R5.4) by @SoldierPePe in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/958
* Mark open plan steps as stopped when

detail.readme:
Craft Anything

English · 日本語 · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 한국어 · Español · Français · Tiếng Việt · Português

See how any website, app or game works, then have AI build your own version; an open-source, clean-room engine in pure Rust.
Point it at a target, say what you want, and it studies the original with real inspection tools,
has a coding agent build a new project, checks the result against the original and refines it.


Download Craft Anything · ArtCraft · All Crafting Apps



A website project: each check says how alike the build is, you approve anything outside the rules, and the plan shows what's left.

> [!NOTE] > **ArtCraft is a community of artists from all walks of life.** Painters, photographers, > filmmakers, illustrators, designers, animators, hobbyists, and people who picked up a pencil > last week. If you make things, you're one of us. **[Come say hi on Discord](https://discord.gg/artcraft).**

How it works · Two ways to use it · AI · Agents · Under the hood · Get started · Status · Downloads · Discord


🔍 Study anything

Websites, desktop apps, phone apps, games and files: real inspection tools find out how they're built and what they do, with the evidence behind every answer.

🛠️ Build your own

Say what you want ("Recreate this website", "Recreate this game's gameplay in Rust") and a coding agent builds a new project in the stack you ask for.

✅ Checked, not guessed

Every build is compared with the original (pages at three screen widths, a game's own self-test, an app's runs) and refined until it's close.

🤖 Agent-ready

320 tools, each one a CLI command and an MCP tool, so any agent can drive the same engine the app uses. No AI is needed to inspect.

## How it works Point Craft Anything at a target, say what you want, and press Start. It works in four steps, asking you in plain words when a decision is yours: 1. **Study:** inspect the original: its pages at every width, its code, its files, how it runs. 2. **Build:** a coding agent builds a new project, in the language, framework or engine your request names (or a sensible default). 3. **Check:** compare the build with the original and list what doesn't match yet. 4. **Ready:** open, play or preview the result, or ask for changes and it refines it.

Make: pick what to recreate, say what you want, press Start.
Ready: play the game, or ask for changes below.
## Two ways to use it - **Simple** (default): "What do you want to make?" Pick a website, app or game, describe it, press Start. A project page shows the four steps (Study → Build → Check → Ready), what the agent is doing in plain words, question and approval cards, how alike the result is, and buttons to open the result or its folder. Ask for changes in the box at the bottom. "Just look inside" opens a target for questions without building anything (in Deep mode). - **Advanced**: the full workbench: every tool (Ctrl/Cmd+K), functions, strings, pseudo-C, disassembly, hex, call graphs, evidence, unknowns, jobs, logs and the agent console. Both modes drive the same engine. ## Clean room or Deep - **Clean room** (the default): nothing inside the original is read, not its code, files or page source. Craft Anything works from what you can see: pictures you add, the website as a visitor sees it (screenshots, visible text, measured layout, colours, fonts and spacing, menus opened) and, when you allow it, a picture of the app's window. Tools that would look inside are refused and say how to turn on Deep mode. - **Deep**: every tool is used, for your private use. A program's code and files are read with the built-in engines (and Ghidra when it's installed), a website's JavaScript is read and its start page watched, and the builder may use all of them. Clean room is a rule about what Craft Anything offers and refuses. It is not an operating-system sandbox: it doesn't isolate your computer. A coding agent you run still acts as you, and what it can read, write or run depends on its own permissions. Which of an agent's own tools Craft Anything can refuse differs by agent; for Claude Code's tools in chats and questions, see [`docs/claude-code.md`](docs/claude-code.md). Switch in the title bar or Settings, with `settings_set deep_mode true`, or for one CLI run with `--deep` (or `--clean-room`).


Advanced: functions, pseudo-C, the agent and the evidence behind every answer.

## AI Building needs a coding agent on your computer. **Claude Code** is supported first: Craft Anything runs your own, unmodified `claude` program, which uses your own sign-in; Craft Anything never sees or handles your account. Your use of it falls under your own agreement with Anthropic. See [docs/claude-code.md](docs/claude-code.md) for how and why. A Codex adapter exists but hasn't been verified on a real install yet. **GitHub Copilot** can use your installed Copilot CLI through ACP: sign in separately with `copilot login`. **Grok Build** can use your installed `grok` program through ACP (`grok agent stdio`): sign in separately with `grok login`. See [docs/grok.md](docs/grok.md). Other agents that speak ACP (Gemini CLI, Qwen Code, opencode, goose, Hermes, Maki, Devin) can be switched to it per backend; of those, Maki and Devin have been run live (Devin authenticates with the backend's stored key — its own CLI sign-in doesn't count over ACP). Anthropic, OpenAI, OpenRouter, xAI (Grok, when `XAI_API_KEY` is set) and local OpenAI-compatible servers are available for questions and analysis (Settings → AI). ## Built for agents Every tool is also a CLI subcommand and an MCP tool, so an agent can study a target or run a whole rebuild without the app: ```sh craft-anything-cli commands # every tool, by toolset craft-anything-cli mcp # serve them to any MCP client craft-anything-cli rebuild https://example.com "Recreate this website" ``` Results are evidence records with their confidence, coverage and limitations; big ones come back as a summary first and are paged with `core_evidence_browse`. `craft-anything-cli setup` connects Craft Anything to coding-agent apps. ## Under the hood A pure-Rust reverse-engineering engine with 320 tools (300 in the engine, the rest from the AI and setup layers) for native programs, .NET, Java, Android, Apple, Electron/JavaScript, websites, firmware, packet captures, databases and game files. Its own decoders, disassembler and decompiler work without any outside program; Deep mode uses them all, and Ghidra when it's installed. It powers the desktop app (egui), the CLI and the MCP server, and parts of it run in the browser as WebAssembly. The full list is in [docs/tools.md](docs/tools.md). ## Get started Requires Rust **1.97 or newer** (a dependency needs it; `rustup update`). On Debian or Ubuntu, the desktop app also needs: ```sh sudo apt-get install libxkbcommon-dev libwayland-dev libx11-dev libxrandr-dev libxi-dev libgl1-mesa-dev libgtk-3-dev ``` Then: ```sh git clone https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything && cd craft-anything cargo run --release -p craft-anything # the desktop app cargo install --path apps/craft-anything-cli # the CLI, as `craft-anything-cli` craft-anything-cli doctor # checks the install, coding agents and engines ``` Building needs a coding agent signed in on your computer (see [AI](#ai)); `doctor` says what's missing. Rebuild from the command line (questions are asked in the terminal): ```sh craft-anything-cli rebuild https://example.com "Recreate this website" craft-anything-cli rebuild - "A snake game in Rust" --rounds 1 craft-anything-cli rebuild https://example.com "Make the header blue" --continue-in "" craft-anything-cli rebuild - "Add a contact form" --project-folder "" --existing edit ``` New projects go in `Documents/Craft Anything` (change it in Settings → General). Each project folder holds `craft.json` (the request, target, status and history), `capture/` (what was recorded from the target), `app/` (the generated project), `checks/` (each comparison against the original), `investigation.cany/` (evidence) and `inbox/` (open questions). A project can also start in a folder you pick (Choose a folder… under Start, or `--project-folder`). If it already has files, you say what they are: the app itself, which the builder edits in place, or material to start from, with the app built in `app/` beside them (Settings → General can remember the answer). Settings → General also lists projects from more folders; removing one only takes it off the list. ## Status > [!IMPORTANT] > **Status:** Craft Anything is in early alpha. What works today, what is partial and what's next: > > - **Works today:** the desktop app (Simple and Advanced), the CLI and the MCP server; the > Study → Build → Check → Refine workflow for websites, apps and games with Claude Code as the > builder; website checks at three screen widths; game rebuilds in Unity, Unreal or Godot; Deep > mode with Ghidra; generated pictures and 3D models (opt-in, your own fal.ai key); plugins (MCP > servers, and WASM components in builds with the `wasm-plugins` option). > - **Partly there:** building with API keys and other coding agents (built, not yet run live), > behaviour checks for apps and games, a few engine tools tested only against stand-ins. > - **Released:** public releases with installers for Windows, macOS, Linux and FreeBSD are > published on the [Releases page](https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/releases); they are > still alpha. > - **Next:** the managed tier. > > [docs/STATUS.md](docs/STATUS.md) has the detail and how each part was checked, > [docs/tool-status.md](docs/tool-status.md) the tool-by-tool checklist, and > [docs/ROADMAP.md](docs/ROADMAP.md) the plan, item by item. Please file issues, or tell us what > broke on [Discord](https://discord.gg/artcraft). **Responsible use.** Use Craft Anything on software you own or are allowed to examine. It never bypasses DRM, logins or anti-cheat. Rebuilds recreate layout, style and behaviour from evidence; the agent is told not to copy logos, photos or text unless you confirm you own them or have permission. **Installing dependencies runs code.** When a builder installs a project's dependencies, the commands run on your computer, and the packages can run code while they install. npm runs each package's install scripts by default, and Rust build scripts and Python source packages run their own setup code. Craft Anything asks before a command of a kind it hasn't seen in this project (`npm`, `cargo`…). Choosing "always allow" for `npm` lets every later npm command run without asking, so only do that for a project whose dependencies you trust. To install npm packages without their install scripts, run `npm install --ignore-scripts`. ## Downloads On GitHub, the [latest release](https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/releases/latest) has every build listed below, and [all releases](https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/releases) has earlier versions and their notes. `` in the file names is the version number, and `SHA256SUMS.txt` lists a checksum for every file. ### Windows | Build | Installer | Portable | |---|---|---| | x64 (64-bit Intel/AMD) | `craft-anything--windows-x64.msi` | `craft-anything--windows-x64-portable.zip` | | arm64 (Snapdragon and other ARM PCs) | `craft-anything--windows-arm64.msi` | `craft-anything--windows-arm64-portable.zip` | | x86 (32-bit) | `craft-anything--windows-x86.msi` | `craft-anything--windows-x86-portable.zip` | Installers and executables are code-signed. The portable zip keeps its settings next to the app. ### macOS | Build | File | Notes | |---|---|---| | App, universal (Apple silicon + Intel) | `craft-anything--macos-universal.dmg` | Signed and notarized | | Command-line tool, universal | `craft-anything-cli--macos-universal.zip` | Signed and notarized; see below if macOS blocks it | Versions after 0.2.0 include the command-line tool in the app, so builds don't need the separate zip. You only need it to use the command line without the app. A browser download of the zip can stop with "Apple could not verify craft-anything-cli" (a lone program can't carry its notarization with it, so macOS has to look it up online). A download from the terminal isn't checked this way, so use this instead: ```sh ver=0.2.0 # change this to the version you want curl -fLO "https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/releases/download/v$ver/craft-anything-cli-$ver-macos-universal.zip" ditto -x -k "craft-anything-cli-$ver-macos-universal.zip" . mkdir -p ~/.local/bin mv "craft-anything-cli-$ver-macos-universal/craft-anything-cli" ~/.local/bin/ ~/.local/bin/craft-anything-cli --version ``` To run it as just `craft-anything-cli`, add `~/.local/bin` to your `PATH`. If you already have the blocked copy, press Done (not Move to Bin), then run `xattr -d com.apple.quarantine `, or allow it in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway. #### Checking that a Mac download is signed and notarized Each Mac release is signed with a Developer ID certificate and notarized by Apple. To check a download yourself, run these in Terminal (replace `` with the version and the paths with yours): ```sh # The disk image: "accepted" and "source=Notarized Developer ID" mean it passed spctl --assess --type open --context context:primary-signature -v "craft-anything--macos-universal.dmg" # The notarization ticket is attached: prints "The validate action worked!" xcrun stapler validate "craft-anything--macos-universal.dmg" # The app, after you open the disk image: the signature must verify codesign --verify --deep --strict --verbose=2 "/Volumes//Craft Anything.app" spctl --assess --type execute --verbose "/Volumes//Craft Anything.app" # The command-line tool: a bare program can't carry a ticket, so macOS checks it online codesign --verify --strict --verbose=2 ~/.local/bin/craft-anything-cli codesign -dv --verbose=4 ~/.local/bin/craft-anything-cli 2>&1 | grep Authority ``` The `Authority` lines should name a "Developer ID Application" certificate. If a check fails, don't run the file; report it with the output and the release tag. ### Linux | Format | x86_64 | aarch64 (ARM64) | Notes | |---|---|---|---| | AppImage | `craft-anything--linux-x86_64.AppImage` | `craft-anything--linux-aarch64.AppImage` | Runs anywhere; updates itself with [AppImageUpdate](https://github.com/AppImageCommunity/AppImageUpdate) (`.zsync` files) | | Flatpak | `craft-anything--linux-x86_64.flatpak` | `craft-anything--linux-aarch64.flatpak` | Sandboxed, so it can't start a browser on your computer, which studying websites needs (use another package for that); `flatpak install --user ` | | Debian/Ubuntu | `craft-anything--linux-x86_64.deb` | `craft-anything--linux-aarch64.deb` | | | Fedora/RHEL/openSUSE | `craft-anything--linux-x86_64.rpm` | `craft-anything--linux-aarch64.rpm` | | | Tarball | `craft-anything--linux-x86_64.tar.gz` | `craft-anything--linux-aarch64.tar.gz` | Unpack anywhere | RISC-V (riscv64): `craft-anything--linux-riscv64.tar.gz`, a tarball only. The AppImage carries the CLI too: run ` --cli ` (for example ` --cli mcp` for an MCP client), or make a link to the AppImage named `craft-anything-cli` and run that. ### FreeBSD | Build | File | |---|---| | x86_64 | `craft-anything--freebsd-x86_64.tar.gz` | ### Web (WebAssembly) | Build | File | Notes | |---|---|---| | Browser viewer | `craft-anything-web-.zip` | Says what a file is, in the browser (the file never leaves it); host the folder on any static web server ([packaging/web/README.md](packaging/web/README.md)) |

Come make things with us

Our Discord is where artists of every kind hang out: people who paint, shoot, draw, cut film, set type, and people still figuring out what they like to make. Share what you're working on, ask for help, tell us what's broken, or tell us what you wish these tools could do. Whatever your medium and however long you've been at it, you're welcome here.

detail.readme_zh:
Craft Anything

English · 日本語 · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 한국어 · Español · Français · Tiếng Việt · Português

看清任意网站、应用或游戏是怎么做的，再让 AI 给你造一个自己的版本；一个纯 Rust 写的开源净室引擎。
把目标指给它，说清你想要什么，它就用真实的检查工具研究原作，
让编码 agent 建一个新项目，把结果与原件比对，再反复收敛。

下载 Craft Anything · ArtCraft · 全部 Crafting 应用



一个网站项目：每项检查都说明构建成果有多像，规则之外的任何动作都要你批准，计划显示还剩什么没做。

> [!NOTE] > **ArtCraft 是一个来自各行各业的创作者社区。** 画家、摄影师、导演、插画师、设计师、动画师、 > 爱好者，以及上周才拿起笔的人。只要你动手做东西，你就是我们的一员。**[来 Discord 打个招呼](https://discord.gg/artcraft)。**

工作原理 · 两种用法 · AI · 面向 agent · 内部实现 · 开始使用 · 状态 · 下载 · Discord


🔍 研究一切

网站、桌面程序、手机应用、游戏和文件：真实的检查工具弄清它们是怎么搭起来的、做了什么，每个结论都带着证据。

🛠️ 造一个自己的

说出你要什么（“复刻这个网站”、“用 Rust 复刻这个游戏的玩法”），编码 agent 就按你指定的技术栈建一个新项目。

✅ 比对过，不是猜的

每个构建都会与原件比对（网页按三种屏宽、游戏跑它自己的自检、应用看它的运行），并反复收敛到足够接近。

🤖 为 agent 准备好

314 个工具，每个既是 CLI 子命令、又是 MCP 工具，任何 agent 都能驱动跟应用同一个引擎。纯研究不需要 AI。

## 工作原理 把 Craft Anything 指向一个目标，说清你要什么，按下 Start。它分四步走，遇到该你拍板的地方就用大白话问你： 1. **研究：** 检查原件：它在各种宽度下的页面、它的代码、它的文件、它怎么运行。 2. **构建：** 编码 agent 建一个新项目，用你的请求指定的语言、框架或引擎（没指定就用合理默认）。 3. **检查：** 把构建成果与原件比对，列出还不一致的地方。 4. **就绪：** 打开、试玩或预览结果，或者继续提要求让它接着收敛。

Make：选择要复刻什么，说出你要什么，按下 Start。
就绪：试玩游戏，或者在下面提改动要求。
## 两种用法 - **简单模式**（默认）：“你想做什么？” 选一个网站、应用或游戏，描述它，按下 Start。项目页显示四个步骤（研究 → 构建 → 检查 → 就绪）、agent 正在做什么（用大白话）、提问卡和审批卡、结果有多像，以及打开结果或它所在文件夹的按钮。在底部的输入框里提改动要求。“只看里面”会打开一个目标供你提问，但不构建任何东西（需深度模式）。 - **进阶模式**：完整的工作台：所有工具（Ctrl/Cmd+K）、函数、字符串、伪 C、反汇编、十六进制、调用图、证据、未知项、任务、日志和 agent 控制台。 两种模式驱动同一个引擎。 ## 净室还是深度 - **净室**（默认）：绝不读取原件内部的任何东西——不读它的代码、文件或页面源码。Craft Anything 只依据你所能看到的来工作：你添加的图片、网站以访客身份呈现的样子（截图、可见文本、测量出的布局、颜色、字体与间距、展开的菜单），以及在你允许时截取的应用窗口画面。所有会往内部看的工具都会被拒绝，并告诉你如何开启深度模式。 - **深度**：使用全部工具，供你自己私下使用。程序的代码和文件由内置引擎读取（装了 Ghidra 时也会用它），网站的 JavaScript 会被读取、起始页面会被持续观察，构建方也可以使用全部这些能力。 在标题栏或设置里切换，或执行 `settings_set deep_mode true`，或单次 CLI 运行时加 `--deep`（或 `--clean-room`）。


进阶：函数、伪 C、agent，以及每个答案背后的证据。

## AI 构建需要你电脑上有一个已登录的编码 agent。**Claude Code** 是首选支持对象：Craft Anything 运行你自己那份未经改动的 `claude` 程序，它用你自己的登录；Craft Anything 从不查看也不接触你的账号，你对它的使用适用你与 Anthropic 自己的协议。原因与做法见 [docs/claude-code.md](docs/claude-code.md)。Codex 适配器已存在，但还没在真实安装上验证过。提问和分析可选用 Anthropic、OpenAI、OpenRouter 以及本地 OpenAI 兼容服务（设置 → AI）。 ## 面向 agent 每个工具同时是一个 CLI 子命令和一个 MCP 工具，所以 agent 不用打开应用也能研究目标或跑完整个重建： ```sh craft-anything-cli commands # every tool, by toolset craft-anything-cli mcp # serve them to any MCP client craft-anything-cli rebuild https://example.com "Recreate this website" ``` 结果是带置信度、覆盖范围和局限性的证据记录；大结果先给摘要，再用 `core_evidence_browse` 分页读取。`craft-anything-cli setup` 把 Craft Anything 接到编码 agent 应用上。 ## 内部实现 一个纯 Rust 的逆向工程引擎，314 个工具（引擎里 298 个，其余来自 AI 与设置层），覆盖原生程序、.NET、Java、Android、Apple、Electron/JavaScript、网站、固件、抓包、数据库和游戏文件。它自带的解码器、反汇编器和反编译器无需任何外部程序即可工作；深度模式会全部用上，装了 Ghidra 时也会使用它。它支撑着桌面应用（egui）、CLI 和 MCP 服务器，其中一部分还能以 WebAssembly 跑在浏览器里。完整清单在 [docs/tools.md](docs/tools.md)。 ## 开始使用 需要 Rust **1.97 或更新**（有依赖要求它；`rustup update`）。在 Debian 或 Ubuntu 上，桌面应用还需要： ```sh sudo apt-get install libxkbcommon-dev libwayland-dev libx11-dev libxrandr-dev libxi-dev libgl1-mesa-dev libgtk-3-dev ``` 然后： ```sh git clone https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything && cd craft-anything cargo run --release -p craft-anything # the desktop app cargo install --path apps/craft-anything-cli # the CLI, as `craft-anything-cli` craft-anything-cli doctor # checks the install, coding agents and engines ``` 构建需要你电脑上已登录一个编码 agent（见 [AI](#ai)）；`doctor` 会告诉你缺什么。从命令行重建（问题在终端里问）： ```sh craft-anything-cli rebuild https://example.com "Recreate this website" craft-anything-cli rebuild - "A snake game in Rust" --rounds 1 craft-anything-cli rebuild https://example.com "Make the header blue" --continue-in "" craft-anything-cli rebuild - "Add a contact form" --project-folder "" --existing edit ``` 新项目放在 `Documents/Craft Anything`（可在设置 → 通用里改）。每个项目文件夹里有 `craft.json`（请求、目标、状态和历史）、`capture/`（从目标录到的内容）、`app/`（生成的项目）、`checks/`（每次与原件比对的结果）、`investigation.cany/`（证据）和 `inbox/`（待回答问题）。 项目也可以从你指定的文件夹开始（Start 下的“选择文件夹…”，或 `--project-folder`）。如果那里已经有文件，你要说明它们是什么：就是应用本身（构建方会就地修改），还是作为起点用的素材（应用会建在它们旁边的 `app/` 里）；设置 → 通用可以记住你的选择。设置 → 通用还会列出其他文件夹里的项目；移除一个只是把它从列表里拿掉。 ## 状态 > [!IMPORTANT] > **状态：** Craft Anything 处于早期 alpha。今天能用的、部分可用的，以及接下来要做的： > > - **今天可用：** 桌面应用（简单与进阶模式）、CLI 和 MCP 服务器；以 Claude Code 作为构建方、面向网站/应用/游戏的 > 研究 → 构建 → 检查 → 收敛 流程；三种屏宽下的网站检查；Unity、Unreal 或 Godot 的游戏重建；带 Ghidra 的深度 > 模式；生成图片和 3D
